title: 4. hdrctl over HTTP: the API is the CLI
description: Start hdrctl serve, call /api/health, then validate a job over HTTP twice — once clean, once broken — and see the JSON response carry the exact same text hdrctl validate prints in a terminal. In about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Scaffold a job and start hdrctl serve
Ask the API how it is doing
Break it — the API fails exactly like the CLI
